test_cases.name: Multipart query with mutation

details.query: match (s:Ship {name: 'Nebuchadnezzar'}) with s as ship merge p = (c:Crew {name: 'Neo'})-[:CrewOf]-(ship) set c.title = 'The One' return p

test_cases.name: Merge labelled node(s) to set a property

details.query: merge (p:Program) set p.name = 'Smith' return p

test_cases.name: Merge labelled node(s) and if not created set a property

details.query: merge (p:Program) on match set p.name = 'Smith' return p

test_cases.name: Merge labelled node(s) and if created set a property

details.query: merge (p:Human) on create set p.born = 'now' return p

test_cases.name: Merge labelled node(s) and do multiple merge actions and set a property

details.query: merge (p:Sentinel) on create set p.emp = 'active' on match set p.emp = 'charged' set p.hunting = true return p

test_cases.name: JD's Create User Example

details.query: merge (x:Base {objectid: '<objId>'}) set x:User, x.name = 'BOB@TEST.LAB' set x += {arr: ['abc', 'def', 'ghi']} return x

test_cases.name: JD's Create Edges Example

details.query: match (x) match (y) merge (x)-[:Edge]->(y)

test_cases.name: Create node

details.query: create (u) return u

test_cases.name: Create node with label

details.query: create (u:Human {name: Neo}) return u

test_cases.name: Create node with decimal properties parameter

details.query: create (a:Label $1) return a

test_cases.name: Create node with named properties parameter

details.query: create (a:Label $named) return a

test_cases.name: Create multiple nodes

details.query: create (a:Label {p: '1234'}), (b:Other) return a, b

test_cases.name: Create relationship

details.query: create p = (:Label {p: '1234'})-[:Link {r: 1234}]->(b {p: '4321'}) return p

test_cases.name: Create relationship with decimal properties parameter

details.query: create p = (:Label {p: '1234'})-[:Link $1]->(b {p: '4321'}) return p

test_cases.name: Create relationship with named properties parameter

details.query: create p = (:Label {p: '1234'})-[:Link $named]->(b {p: '4321'}) return p

test_cases.name: Create relationship with matching

details.query: match (a), (b) where a.name = 'a' and b.linked = id(a) create p = (a)-[:Linked]->(b) return p

test_cases.name: Set node properties

details.query: match (n:Human {name: Neo}) set n.one = true return n

test_cases.name: Set node properties with map

details.query: match (b:Thing) set b += {prop1: '123', lprop: [1, [2, 3, 4], {a: 1234}]} return b

test_cases.name: Set node property to null

details.query: match (b:Thing) set b.prop = null return b

test_cases.name: Set node property to other node property

details.query: match (a:User), (b:Admin) set a.prop = b.prop

test_cases.name: Set node labels

details.query: match (b:Thing) set b:Other return b

test_cases.name: Set multiple node properties

details.query: match (b:Thing) set b.name = '123', b.other = '123' return b

test_cases.name: Set multiple node properties with multiple updating clauses

details.query: match (b:Thing) set b.name = '123' set b:Label return b

test_cases.name: Remove node properties

details.query: match (b:Thing) remove b.name return b

test_cases.name: Remove multiple node properties

details.query: match (b:Thing) remove b.name, b.other return b

test_cases.name: Remove multiple node properties with multiple updating clauses

details.query: match (b:Thing) remove b.name remove b:Label return b

test_cases.name: Remove node properties from node pattern

details.query: match (a:Agent {name: Smith}) remove a.trapped return a

test_cases.name: Delete node

details.query: match (b:Thing) delete b return b

test_cases.name: Delete node with node pattern

details.query: match (u:Human {name: Dozer}) delete u

details.query: match (b:Thing) detach delete b return b

test_cases.name: Delete detach nodes

details.query: match (a:Thing1), (b:Thing2) detach delete a, b return b
